item.title: Simple Sprout Shop Logo

turns.text: Make a square logo for my plant shop, Little Sprout. Just a simple green sprout above the name on white, nothing fancy.

item.tests: Produces a usable simple logo combining a clear mark and a readable business name.

answer_sheet.Mark and style: A simple green sprout above the name; clean and unfussy.

must_haves: A recognizable, simple green sprout sits above the name.
The square image contains a flat logo, not a photograph or merchandise mockup.

turns.text: Make a square logo for my plant shop, Little Sprout. Just a simple green sprout above the name on white, nothing fancy. I'm on the free plan and don't want my credits burned, so please tell me what it'll cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
For **Little Sprout**, the cheapest approach is a simple **SVG logo I write directly here: 0 Magic Hour credits**. It would have a green sprout above the shop name on white, in a square layout. SVG stays sharp at any size.

If you prefer AI generation:
- **Smallest free-plan option:** one square image at 640px using Flux Schnell or Flux 2 Klein.
- **Listed starting cost:** **5 credits per image**. I can’t verify the final charge with the tools available here.
- A shorter prompt or simpler design won’t lower that listed minimum. Generating just one small image avoids extra variation costs.

**Nothing has run or spent credits.** Would you like the **zero-credit SVG** instead?
